final_message:
All 6 tests in `python3 run_tests.py` now pass. I also ran some extra checks on documented behaviour the visible tests don't cover: amounts under a dollar like `-$0.05`, zero, `0.5`, and tied totals. All of those came out right.

Bugs fixed:

1. **`ledger/money.py` – `format_cents`**: negative amounts came out wrong (`-310` became `-$-4.90`) because the division and remainder ran on the negative number. It now works on the absolute value and adds the `-` sign separately.
2. **`ledger/parse.py` – `parse_date`**: month and day were swapped in the returned tuple. It now returns `(year, month, day)`. This also fixes the date in `parse_record`.
3. **`ledger/report.py` – `top_items`**: items were sorted by total from smallest to largest, and ties had no defined order. The sort is now largest total first, with ties ordered by item name A–Z. This also fixes `summary_line`.
